about: Oil Refineries Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells finished petroleum products, intermediate products, and aromatics in Israel, Asia, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Refining, Polymers, Investments in an Oil Asset, and Other segments. The company offers gasoline, naphtha, diesel fuel, kerosene, fuel oil, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), and bitumen to fuel and gas marketing companies; and infrastructure services, including the storage, pumping, and distribution of petroleum products.
